title: SubmissionFailedPayload
description: Payload of the SubmissionFailed event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8; class: domain). Authored by INV-T-2854 (T10). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

retryDisposition.description: How the failure is worked off, e.g. AUTO_RETRY, MANUAL, TERMINAL (model/architecture/error-codes.yaml 'disposition').

code.description: The error-catalogue code that opened the exception (INV-REQ-940). Absent when the producer does not know it; never guessed by the consumer.

remediationOwner.description: The effective owner of that code, as Exception.remediationOwner of console-bff/openapi.yaml (INV-REQ-940). Absent when the producer does not know it; never guessed by the consumer.

disposition.description: The base disposition of the code in the error catalogue, read as Exception.disposition of console-bff/openapi.yaml: AUTO_RELEASE, AUTO_RETRY, MANUAL, OVERRIDABLE, TERMINAL; extensible (INV-REQ-940). Absent when the producer does not know it; never guessed by the consumer.
